jobs.description:
Company Overview

The Enlyte Family of Businesses

Mitchell | Genex | Coventry

Enlyte is the parent brand of Mitchell, Genex and Coventry, an organization unlike any other in the Property & Casualty industry, bringing together three great businesses with a shared vision of using technology innovation, clinical services and network solutions to help our customers and the people they serve. Our suite of products and services enable our employees to help people recover from challenging life events, while providing opportunities for meaningful impact and career growth.

Job Description

Are you a compassionate Registered Nurse with a compact license
, ready to make a meaningful impact in the lives of injured workers? We're seeking a dedicated Worker's Compensation Case Manager to join our remote team
, where you'll leverage your clinical expertise to guide individuals through their recovery journey and facilitate their return to work. This rewarding role offers the flexibility of working from anywhere in the U.S., comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to transform lives while advancing your career in case management.

Perks:
Full and comprehensive benefits program, 24 days of paid vacation/holidays in your first year plus sick days, home office equipment including laptop and desktop monitor, Employee Assistance and Referral Program, and hands-on workers’ compensation case management training.

As a Telephonic Case Manager, you will work closely with treating physicians/providers, employers, customers, legal representatives, and the injured/disabled person to create and implement a treatment plan that returns the injured/disabled person back to work appropriately, ensure appropriate and cost-effective healthcare services, achievement of maximum medical recovery and return to an optimal level of work and functioning. In this role, you will:

Demonstrate knowledge, skills, and competency in the application of case management standards of practice.
Use advanced knowledge of types of injury, medications, comorbidities, treatment options, treatment alternatives, and knowledge of job duties to advise on a treatment plan.
Interview disabled persons to assess overall recovery, including whether injuries or conditions are occupational or non-occupational.
Collaborate with treating physicians/providers and utilize available resources to help create and implement treatment plans tailored to an individual patient.
Work with employers and physicians to modify job duties where practical to facilitate early return to work.
Evaluate and modify case goals based on injured/disabled person’s improvement and treatment effectiveness.
Independently manage workload, including prioritizing cases and deciding how best to manage cases effectively.
Complete other duties, such as prepare status updates for submittal to customers, assist in training/orientation of new staff as requested, and other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education: Associates Degree or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing or related field.
Experience: 2+ years clinical practice preferred. Workers’ compensation-related experience preferred.
Skills: Ability to advocate recommendations effectively with physicians/providers, employers, and customers. Ability to work independently. Knowledge of basic computer skills including Excel, Word, and Outlook Email. Proficient grammar, sentence structure, and written communication skills.
Certifications, Licenses, Registrations:
Active Compact Registered Nurse (RN) license required. Must be in good standing.
URAC-recognized certification in case management may be required (CCM, CDMS, CRC, CRRN or COHN, COHN-S, RN-BC, ACM, CMAC, CMC).

Internet: Must have reliable internet.

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $74,000 - $86,000 annually and includes eligibility to participate in a performance based bonus program. Your compensation will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Title: Training Coordinator NAMER - SKIL

Grade: 9

Location: Belgrade (hybrid)

The Training Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, coordination, and execution of global learning operations that support NCR Atleos field associates, instructors, and business stakeholders. The role ensures that training schedules, enrollments, learning-system activities, onboarding support, reporting, vendor coordination, and compliance requirements are completed accurately and on time. KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY

Coordinating Training Operations

Monitor the global Training Coordinator mailbox and provide support to sister regions as needed.
Complete instructor requests related to session administration and other LMS activities.
Identify and report NCRU concerns, discrepancies, and process issues to the Global Learning team.
Support learning programs, deployments, and rollouts, including programs such as TM Academy.
Provide customers and internal stakeholders with training on NCRU operations and processes as needed.
Register learners for classes in response to approved requests.
Monitor enrollments and support achievement of the 80% course fill-rate target.
Support field-initiated programs, including OFS activities, as needed.
Provide operational support to regional Learning Business Partners.
Support instructor certification requirements for newly introduced classes.
Manage NCRU tickets and follow them through to resolution or appropriate escalation.

Training Schedule Management

Analyze training demand, business requirements, and identified skill gaps to support schedule development.
Create a training schedule that supports field and regional business needs.
Communicate the finalized schedule and subsequent updates to the business.
Maintain the training schedule and make necessary adjustments when demand, capacity, or instructor availability changes.
Coordinate training dates with Paul, Ricky, and the instructor team.
Monitor class fill rates and other operational factors to determine whether classes should be confirmed or canceled.
Send targeted or last-minute invitations to the business when class enrollment is below target.
Monitor low-enrollment classes and coordinate cancellation decisions and communications when required.
Maintain the instructor schedule and publish the current version to SharePoint.
Create schedules and manage enrollments for Piece Parts and Targeted Training programs.

New Hire Onboarding Support

Work with Human Resources to understand hiring plans, expected volumes, and onboarding schedules.
Track completion of the mentoring checklist.
Maintain new-hire welcome letters and onboarding communication templates.
Maintain new-hire onboarding trackers and ensure information remains current.
Confirm that new hires complete all prerequisite tasks and required tests before attending training.
Send welcome letters and required pre-training information to new hires.

Reporting and Analysis

Provide learning reports to customers and business stakeholders as requested.
Prepare training enrollment update reports.
Prepare training outlook and actuals reports for the Finance team.
Analyze skill gaps and participation data to identify areas where additional training promotion or scheduling is required.
Report sessions delivered by instructor.
Prepare learner evaluation reports.
Report completed sessions and the number of learners trained.
Produce reports on class fill rates, cancellations, no-shows, enrollments, attendance, and completion trends.

Managing Expenses and Vendors

Facilitate the ordering of supplies, training materials, and course materials required for delivery.
Ensure expenses are approved in advance where required and remain aligned with the approved budget.
Submit expense claims within the timeframe required by policy and include all required receipts and supporting documentation.
Provide the hotel and Security team with learner numbers on a weekly basis.
Communicate changes in learner schedules and attendance requirements to the hotel.
Meet with the hotel on a quarterly basis to review concerns, service levels, and operational requirements.
Coordinate payment of internet services for the Monrovia and Edison training locations.
Coordinate processing of electricity statements for the Torrance training location.

Ensure all course rosters are closed no later than the day following the end of the class.
When moving a learner from one class to another, process the withdrawal first to preserve accurate reporting.
Use the approved terminology and correct reason codes when processing class withdrawals.
Monitor, report, and escalate learner no-shows in accordance with the established process.
Create and maintain job aids for all training coordination processes on the designated shared site.
Provide a monthly update to the Leadership team covering completed activities, learning metrics, operational needs, risks, and required support.
Update Learning metrics on a monthly basis and validate data quality before publication.
Apply continuous improvement practices to strengthen training operations, reporting accuracy, and the learner experience.

Basic Qualifications

Associate's degree in Business Administration, Education, Human Resources, Learning and Development, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
2-4 years of experience in training administration, learning operations, scheduling, program coordination, or a related area.
Experience using a learning management system and completing learner, session, roster, and enrollment administration.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong organizational, planning, and customer-service skills, with close attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholder requests in a fast-paced, matrix-managed environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
Ability to analyze operational data, identify issues, and escalate risks appropriately.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with global and regional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Education, Business, Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field.
Experience supporting a global or multi-regional learning organization.
Experience with NCRU, Cornerstone LMS, or a comparable enterprise learning platform.
Advanced Excel skills and experience preparing operational dashboards, forecasts, and management reports.
Experience coordinating instructor-led, virtual instructor-led, and blended learning programs.
Knowledge of learning metrics, roster compliance, enrollment processes, and training scheduling practices.
Experience coordinating vendors, facilities, materials, and learning-related expenses.
Experience developing job aids, process documentation, and standardized operating procedures.
Proven ability to adapt to changing priorities and identify opportunities for process improvement.
